Include your access token in the tokenKey field of the request body to view the token information.
A reference token is an alias for a longer token and is not retrievable after creation.
The app id and the app secret can be joined by a pipe and passed in the access_token parameter of a server-side call.
The refresh_token member is returned only if the external client app has the refresh_token scope.
